English: Rope Corral
A makeshift horse enclosure of rope and turf, hastily erected on the steppe to keep the herd together and safe from predators.
Breeders Hut
A small yurt or hut where experienced breeders tend to foaling mares and select bloodlines, raising the quality of the herd.
Foal Pen
A sturdy enclosure for young foals, protected from the elements and predators, ensuring better survival and growth rates.
Stallion Stand
A dedicated stand and paddock for prized stallions, guarded and maintained by trusted herdsmen, providing stronger and faster offspring.
Mares Pavilion
A large felt pavilion dedicated to the care and breeding of the clans best mares, fostering increased herd fertility and unity.
Horse Trainers Room
A specialized yurt for elite horse trainers to teach advanced riding and herd management, increasing the speed and discipline of the nomadic horde.
Champion Stable
A fortified stable complex for the hordes champion horses, guarded round the clock, breeding the clans most legendary mounts.
Steppe Stud Hall
A grand wooden hall at the heart of the encampment, where the finest stallions and mares are paired, and horsemen gather to plan future raids.
Grand Herd Pavilion
A massive felt and timber structure, home to the legendary herds of the Altaic clans, where trade, feasts, and the selection of warhorses take place.
Altaic Horse Stud
The pinnacle of Altaic horse breeding: a legendary stud complex, forging the fastest and strongest horses known to the steppe, symbol of unrivaled prestige.
